# Firstpost

> > Firstpost is India's leading English news platform delivering comprehensive coverage of global geopolitics, entertainment, sports, and lifestyle from an Indian perspective.

Firstpost provides in-depth analysis and breaking news across international affairs, with particular focus on West Asia conflicts, India-Pakistan relations, US-China dynamics, and Indian cinema's global recognition. The platform combines hard news with cultural coverage, offering expert commentary on geopolitical developments and their impact on Indian interests.

## Key Topics

- Iran-Israel conflict
- West Asia geopolitics
- India-Pakistan relations
- US foreign policy
- Indian cinema and Oscars
- BRICS and Global South
- Energy markets and oil prices
- China-US relations
- T20 World Cup 2026
- Bollywood and entertainment
- Middle East conflicts
- Taliban-Pakistan tensions
- Dollar hegemony
- Celebrity news
- Cricket analysis
